openQuestions.question: Most "instances" are panels of one scrollEnlargeSnap group, not sections. Plan builds 4 snap sections (home, dining, wellness, meetings) whose items are the panel instances. Confirm.

Wellness and meetings: the intro and start frame sit in wellness-collection/02 and meetings-collection/02 (Q023 tab-pills-intro, is-media-center), but the snap root must contain both the frame and the panels. Either Q023 hands its intro to venue-card-fullbleed_intro (this plan supports it: intro header plus tabs) or Q023 hosts the snap markup with these classes.
openQuestions.default: venue-card-fullbleed owns the whole snap section; Q023 drops those two instances. Needs the Q023 plan and K01 to agree.

openQuestions.question: Legal and corporate 06 to 09 have no animation note and no start frame. Static stack of four cards, or a snap group that starts full size?
Webflow component shape: one component for static cards with props, snap groups as plain sections using the same classes. Alternative: one component per snap group with no props.

home/15 venue list (council boardroom, courtyard, conference center): rows fade towards the bottom in Figma. Static links with the first row is-active, or does it switch the background image on hover?
openQuestions.default: Static links, first row is-active, no JS.

openQuestions.question: meetings-collection/03 is a #D9D9D9 placeholder with a #484848 square in Figma: which image goes there, and is the square a real element (logo or badge)?
openQuestions.default: Base panel; image to come; square ignored.

openQuestions.question: Dining tabs read "lobby terrace" but panel 07 is "garden terrace". Which name?
openQuestions.default: Use the panel name (garden terrace) for both.

openQuestions.question: Logo panels (Zuma, The Lobby Bar, Pool Lounge) have a wordmark and no text heading. Keep a visually hidden h3 with the venue name for headings order, or rely on the logo alt text?
openQuestions.default: Logo alt only; the tabs and intro give context.

openQuestions.question: clip-path (chamfered frame, tabs and button) may not be settable through the Designer API. Fallback: a small site-wide CSS block in the head custom code for these three selectors.
openQuestions.default: Try the style panel; fall back to site CSS.

openQuestions.question: is-left (home/15) shares the frame, content and button with the family but adds a grid layout and a venue list. Keep it as a modifier or split it into its own unique section?
openQuestions.default: Kept as a modifier because the classes and DOM are shared. If the Designer build finds the grid fights the base content, build home/15 as a unique section instead (orchestrator guidance: when unsure, prefer a unique item).

deviations.why: home/11 has two image nodes with the same imageRef and the same box; one image renders the same result. Only is-tall is kept.

deviations.what: is-left + is-media-center on dining-collection/03 becomes is-media-center plus the optional tabs nav
deviations.why: The "left" text is the tab labels inside a centred tab bar; the frame and content are not left aligned. The tabs are an optional element, not a variant.

deviations.what: is-cream + is-no-image on meetings-collection/03 becomes a base panel with no image
deviations.why: The crop is a #D9D9D9 placeholder card on the cream page, the same chrome as every base card. Without an image the media background (color-neutral-300) shows; no modifier needed.

deviations.what: is-media-center is a snap group start state, not a static layout
deviations.why: home/04 and dining/03 are the first frame of Home-Animation-1. The modifier sets the start size that scrollEnlargeSnap enlarges.
The frame is full bleed with a 2.5rem gap (the snap stage padding); a max-width container would stop the enlarge at 80rem.
Figma varies 0.3 to 0.45 per instance with no visible intent; per-instance values are in instances[].figmaScrimOpacity.

deviations.what: Modifiers are set on each element they change
deviations.why: Webflow cannot style descendants from a parent combo class, so is-tall, is-left and is-media-center are applied to the stage, media, content and header elements as listed in variants.

deviations.what: Q021 build (2026-10-20): the component is the static base card only
deviations.why: Webflow components cannot repeat items (Q021-OQ4), and an instance cannot switch the is-tall, is-left or is-media-center combos (same as Q014, Q017, Q019). The snap groups and the is-tall and is-left cards are plain reference sections on the build page.

deviations.what: Q021 build: the wellness, meetings, legal and corporate groups were not built on the build page
deviations.why: They reuse the home and dining snap structure or the base component with different content; they are placed when the real pages are built.

deviations.what: Q021 build: no loading attribute on snap images
deviations.why: data-eager is set, and eagerImages() promotes those images to eager at runtime; a custom loading attribute could clash with the Image element's own setting.

deviations.what: Q021 build: the dining tab and panel 07 both read garden terrace
deviations.why: Q021-OQ7 default. Home panel 08 keeps lobby terrace.

deviations.what: Q021 build: no static is-active on the dining tabs
deviations.why: scrollEnlargeSnap sets is-active and aria-current on the active tab at runtime. The home/15 list keeps a static is-active on its first row (Q021-OQ5).

deviations.what: Q021 build: the is-left list rows are Link Blocks holding a div.heading-style-h3 TextBlock
deviations.why: The builder ignores set_text on a TextBlock; the text was written with set_settings key text.

deviations.what: Q021 build: Button Link is a url prop defaulting to #
deviations.why: Instance link props accept only url, email, phone, popover and modal modes (Q019 finding).
